executiveSummary.headline: Resolve Official Inventory Conflicts and Surface Distinctive Cap Cana Assets
executiveSummary.lead: The St. Regis Cap Cana Resort appears in 32 of 47 eligible scenarios and ranks seventh among 11 certified Marriott Bonvoy peers. Its official pages describe a rich resort—signature dining, The Amber Room, Punta Espada, oceanfront events, and multiple pools—but conflicting inventory counts and low ADP recognition for several of those assets make source-of-truth control the first priority.
executiveSummary.metricsNote: AI Consideration is the share of 188 comparable monitored answers mentioning the resort; Scenario Presence is the share of 47 eligible traveler-need scenarios where it appeared. Certified Peer Position uses the 11-hotel Marriott Bonvoy set. These measures do not represent bookings, ADR, revenue, or traveler exposure.

themes.title: Dining Inventory Uses Three Different Counting Frames
themes.what: The overview says eight culinary venues, later says nine culinary and beverage experiences, and lists four restaurants plus four bars.
themes.whyItMatters: Guests and partners need a stable distinction among restaurants, bars, cafés, and in-room dining.

themes.title: Events Area Requires a Counting Bridge
themes.what: The events page presents 6,192, more than 7,000, over 11,200, and over 23,200 square feet.
themes.whyItMatters: Indoor, outdoor, gross, and sellable space must be labeled explicitly for planners.

themes.title: Several Signature Assets Are Under-Recognized
themes.what: ADP recorded 0% for restaurant, meetings, golf access, and signature bar, despite detailed official content.
themes.whyItMatters: This is a prioritization signal for clearer facts, not evidence of booking or ranking causation.

executiveSummary.successLooksLike: Official dining, pool, and event inventories reconcile to signed definitions; Punta Espada and signature outlet facts are consistent across priority pages; and Marriott documents the intended automated-access posture.
executiveSummary.closing: The resort already has differentiated assets. The highest-value work is to make those assets internally consistent, setup-qualified, and easy for a buyer to verify.

actions.headline: Review Marriott Origin Access for Intended Crawlers
actions.priorityWhy: The bounded probe returned different GET and HEAD behavior at the Marriott origin.
actions.whatWeFound: The zero-cost research probe received HTTP 403 and a redirect to default.mi for a GET to the Marriott origin, while HEAD and robots.txt returned HTTP 200. Official resort URLs remained retrievable through separate web fetch.
actions.whyItMatters: The mixed result warrants a security-aligned review but does not establish a general outage or indexing failure.
recommendedSteps: Open a Marriott CDN/WAF review with the exact test context.
Confirm intended crawler policy.
Approve only narrow changes if a conflict is verified.
Retest origin and resort URLs.
actions.suggestedTimeframe: Review in 2 weeks; approved updates within 30–45 days

methodology.scope: Combines the pinned certified ADP baseline with a bounded review of named public pages and zero-cost technical probes. No paid research, ADP remeasurement, production write, or customer publication was performed.
claimTypeGuide: VERIFIED_ISSUE — a directly observed, source-backed discrepancy.
RECOMMENDED_INVESTIGATION — evidence warrants review but does not prove a defect or cause.
REQUIRES_HOTEL_CONFIRMATION — leadership must establish the source of truth before correction.
OPTIONAL_COMMERCIAL_OPPORTUNITY — proceed only if leadership wants the demand.
responsibilities: Hotel leadership confirms facts, priorities, and public changes.
Digital, brand, and partner teams implement only approved corrections and document verification.
Dealality packages measurement context and evidence without implying ranking, booking, ADR, or revenue causation.
methodology.monthlyReviewRelationship: Approved actions may be tracked later. Completing an action does not itself prove a change in AI presence, bookings, ADR, or revenue.
methodology.nextStep: Approve the highest-priority source-of-truth decision, then authorize only the validated work.

strongestFindings: The official overview says eight culinary venues, then nine experiences, while amenities list four restaurants and four bars.
One official events page presents 6,192, more than 7,000, over 11,200, and over 23,200 square feet without a clear counting bridge.
The experiences page markets four pools while its FAQ says one outdoor pool.
